criteria.call: does the LHB net-buy dual-HMA state time 510300 after cost?

passes.beats_null: the phase-null p (share of shifts that match or beat it) < 0.05
passes.drawdown: max drawdown not worse than the benchmark's

criteria.execution: signal at close t, weight from open t+1, mark to close

frozen_rule: institutional seats' (buy - sell) summed per day / CSI300 turnover, HMA(30) vs HMA(100), long 0.9 on agreement outside zero, flat in the middle
tested_rule: all-seat net buy (龙虎榜净买额) summed per day after de-duplicating (代码, 上榜日) / sh510300 traded value, HMA(30) vs HMA(100), long 0.9 on agreement outside zero, flat in the middle
verdict_scope: the tested rule, not the frozen one: the institutional-seat numerator is absent from the in-repo LHB face, so this verdict says nothing about the frozen institutional-only variant
deviations: numerator is all-seat net buy (龙虎榜净买额), not institutional seats: Money02/data/lhb/lhb_detail.parquet has no seat column (data precondition in the registry row fails, downgrade applied)
de-duplicated on (代码, 上榜日) preferring a same-day 上榜原因: the panel repeats a stock per reason and a '连续三个交易日' reason reports a multi-day cumulative net buy, not that day's
a stock-day carrying only cumulative-window rows keeps its cumulative reading (the count is printed) rather than being dropped
a trading day with no LHB events counts as 0 net buy
normaliser is sh510300 traded value (CSI300 turnover is not in the repo); the raw un-normalised leg is published beside it
long weight 0.9 per the berth, so the 1.0 buy-and-hold benchmark differs in exposure -- the long share is printed, never tuned
verdict_reasons: phase null p=0.055 does not beat 5%
